blocks.raw: You can download a report to an Excel sheet for offline analysis. Both standard and custom reports are available for download. The downloaded report includes the entire dataset, including segment-level data for each KPI and the filters applied.
blocks.text: You can download a report to an Excel sheet for offline analysis. Both standard and custom reports are available for download. The downloaded report includes the entire dataset, including segment-level data for each KPI and the filters applied.

blocks.raw:
1. Open the report that you want to download.
2. Click the calendar to select the desired time period for generating the report.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/74c5aff6755abf08cb4df18270e73e140a9c96854abeec9b354c3f0805d92354-Screenshot_2025-10-07_at_11.40.21_AM.png" className="border" />
3. Click the **More** Options icon > **Download Report**.

   <Image align="center" border={true} src="https://files.readme.io/d8b2f862308259ed8a57b18f82bbeeaa072d223566241d9c9c58031243a35b9c-Insight_report_download.png" className="border" />
blocks.text: Open the report that you want to download.Click the calendar to select the desired time period for generating the report.Click the More Options icon > Download Report.

blocks.raw: You will see the report summary in the first sheet and data of each chart in different tabs as shown below.
blocks.text: You will see the report summary in the first sheet and data of each chart in different tabs as shown below.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note
>
> The maximum download size for a report is **512 KB**. If your report exceeds this limit, an error message appears. To download all data, divide the report into smaller time frames and export each part separately.
blocks.text: NoteThe maximum download size for a report is 512 KB. If your report exceeds this limit, an error message appears. To download all data, divide the report into smaller time frames and export each part separately.
